result_semantic_payload.summary: The device holds a compact, coherent payment-collection evidence set plus one document that must be excluded. PRIMARY evidence: /data/收款记录.txt (payment collection records) logs three dated USDT (Tether) collections from three distinct payers — 2023-11-02 陈某 USDT 30,000 into bank card 6222020212345678901; 2023-11-04 周某 USDT 17,500 into wallet 0xDEAD1111; 2023-11-09 吴某 USDT 52,000 into the same wallet 0xDEAD1111 — totaling USDT 99,500, with a repeated crypto wallet (0xDEAD1111) and a PRC bank card as collection endpoints. SUPPORTING/corroborating evidence: /platform/说明.txt (platform operation notes) identifies internal platform 聚宝盆, admin backend http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a customer-service recruitment quota of 20 new users/day/group, indicating an organized collection/recruitment operation. EXCLUDED from the evidentiary chain: /personal/体检报告.txt, a private physical-examination/medical report (name 陈某, dated 2023-10-20). Per the device manifest /README.txt and the document's own text it has no evidential relation to the payment operation and must not be cited as evidence of it — even though the name 陈某 overlaps with a payer in the collection records, that overlap must not be used to fold the medical record into the payment chain (spurious correlation + sensitive health data).

claim_candidates.text: The device's primary payment-collection evidence is /data/收款记录.txt, which records three dated USDT collections from three distinct payers: 2023-11-02 陈某 USDT 30,000 (bank card 6222020212345678901); 2023-11-04 周某 USDT 17,500 (wallet 0xDEAD1111); 2023-11-09 吴某 USDT 52,000 (wallet 0xDEAD1111), totaling USDT 99,500.

A single crypto wallet 0xDEAD1111 received two of the three collections (周某 17,500 and 吴某 52,000 = USDT 69,500), and a PRC bank card 6222020212345678901 received the third (陈某 30,000), indicating consolidated collection endpoints.

/platform/说明.txt corroborates an organized collection/recruitment operation: internal platform name 聚宝盆, admin backend http://jbpenl-admin.example, and a customer-service recruitment quota of 20 new users per group per day.

/personal/体检报告.txt is a private physical-examination/medical report (name 陈某, dated 2023-10-20; blood pressure normal, blood lipids elevated) and must be excluded from the payment-collection evidentiary chain.
The exclusion rule is authoritative: /README.txt is a seizure manifest directing that the personal directory's contents must not be cited as evidence of the payment operation.

limitations: Evidence is limited to four small text files; no registry, event-log, prefetch, amcache, browser, or binary artifacts were present, so execution/persistence claims cannot be corroborated here.

Content was read at preview level; files carry no MD5 hash and no distinct filesystem modified-time (mtime equals ctime/seizure time), so integrity hashing and true last-modified attribution are unavailable.
The payment figures and endpoints are as recorded in /data/收款记录.txt and are not independently verified against external financial or blockchain sources.
The medical-report exclusion rests on the device README manifest and the report's own self-description; no separate legal-hold or privilege determination is available in this scope.
warnings: Name overlap risk: payer 陈某 in the collection record shares a name with the subject of the excluded medical report /personal/体检报告.txt; do not use this overlap to associate the medical document with the payment operation.
The excluded medical report contains sensitive personal health data and should be handled under privacy controls even though it is outside the evidentiary chain.
